Import a profile from the clipboard, a file, or a QR code, select it as active, and tap Start.\n\nURL subscriptions are supported for compatible VPN configurations, including v2raytun-compatible node lists and smart profiles.

Profiles store connection parameters: server, protocol, keys, routes, and tunnel settings.

In Profiles, you can choose the active profile, refresh a subscription, view or edit the configuration, and export the configuration.

Manual edits inside a subscription profile can be replaced by the next subscription refresh.

Refresh is available for URL subscriptions. Foxhole downloads the latest configuration from the VPN provider. If the profile is already connected to the VPN tunnel, the app reconnects it to apply the changes.

Smart start chooses a working VPN protocol for the current network.

It tries the best available protocols, validates the connection, and keeps the first confirmed result. Full refresh checks every available protocol separately and updates latency, status, and recommendations.

Smart start data stays on the device: saved latency, statuses, recommendations, and connection history are not sent out.

Smart start settings appear automatically after Foxhole detects a smart profile. In settings, you can change connection timeouts, choose the UDP / TCP / All transport priority, or clear local Smart start data.

Protocol menu legend:

★ Fast - the fastest successful option from saved measurements.

★★ Best - the protocol Foxhole recommends for connection based on the latest checks.
Up to 250 ms. The best everyday connection option.
251–750 ms. The connection works, but may not be the fastest.
751–1500 ms. The protocol works, but connection quality is lower.
Above 1500 ms. Use only when other options are unavailable.
Foxhole could not get a valid latency or ping measurement.
Analysis has not run yet, or there are no saved results.
The protocol was turned off manually and does not participate in auto-connect.

Fast - latency up to 250 ms. Usually the best option for everyday connection.

Normal - latency from 251 to 750 ms. The connection works, but may not be the fastest.

Slow - latency from 751 to 1500 ms. The protocol works, but connection quality is lower.

Very slow - latency above 1500 ms. Use it only when other options are unavailable.

Down - the latest protocol check failed. This protocol should not appear as recommended after a fresh failed result.

Unavailable - Foxhole could not get a valid latency or ping measurement for this protocol.

No data - analysis has not run yet, or there are no saved results for this protocol.

Off - the protocol was turned off manually and does not participate in auto-connect until the user turns it back on.

Tor mode routes supported TCP traffic through Tor. Some apps, UDP traffic, push services, streaming, and banking apps may fail or become slower.
Tor will not run for the selected UDP VPN protocol. Only TCP VPN profiles can carry Tor-over-VPN.

Diagnostics shows connection logs, traffic statistics, and sanitized archive export.

The sanitized archive does not contain IP addresses or configurations. It is used to debug connection, import, subscription, and Smart start issues.

If the problem repeats, open Diagnostics, create a sanitized archive without IP addresses or configurations, and send it to the Telegram support bot.

If Telegram is not installed, Foxhole opens the link in a browser.
